dct_title_s: Central African Republic - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Central African Republic administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 20 Préfecture - Admin 2: 85 Sous-préfecture Dates associated with this dataset: - 06 March 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 30 May 2024: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 January 2023: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 January 2003: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-car). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
